scientific_question: Can a materially different fused streaming runtime remove the native proposal memory blocker while preserving the frozen dual-K1 mathematics and its complete operator-call advantage?
scope: synthetic pre-fit mechanism gate only; no fit, fresh, validation, or test trajectory may be opened

motivation.reason: the minimum reduction is the exact shortfall between the frozen v12.5 single-pass candidate and 1.05 times its reference

permitted_mechanism_change: move float64-to-float32 conversion, RMS normalization, odd positive-negative construction, odd recombination, and RMS rescaling into the native runtime
replace per-convolution pthread creation with one persistent four-worker pool using explicitly bounded stacks; each worker evaluates complete samples so layer synchronization is removed
allocate one reusable native workspace at construction with three one-sample feature scratch tensors per worker instead of three full-batch feature tensors

use one bounded look-ahead so the next eight-frame proposal chunk may run concurrently while the current eight-frame chunk is consumed by the unchanged exact A-transpose lift, observable alpha, and strict CGLS K1; no more than two proposal chunks may coexist
write candidate and reference fields incrementally to the same NPY-compatible sequential output contract without mapping the full trajectory

preformal_engineering_dry_run.checkpoint_used: temporary deterministic random arrays with the correct tensor shapes; not the frozen trained checkpoint
preformal_engineering_dry_run.data_used: the protocol synthetic Gaussian observations only
preformal_engineering_dry_run.purpose: exercise all 15 worker processes and the independent validator before binding the formal execution
preformal_engineering_dry_run.finding: the serial chunk implementation passed numerical and memory plumbing but left proposal inference and Dual-K1 refinement non-overlapped, so it failed the unchanged wall gate
preformal_engineering_dry_run.single_permitted_correction: add one bounded proposal look-ahead and sample-parallel reusable scratch without changing weights, network arithmetic, solver, calls, metrics, thresholds, batch size, precision, or data; an infrastructure-only Python coordinator passed the wall plumbing but exceeded the RSS gate by about 0.53 MB, so the same look-ahead coordinator was moved into a 64 KiB native thread, and a failed on-demand-SiLU scratch attempt was discarded because it recomputed activations and failed the unchanged wall gate

formal_execution.arm_order: rotating v12.5 candidate, v13 candidate, v13 streaming Zero-K4 reference
formal_execution.wall_scope: proposal plus solver and incremental output write; excludes process startup, one-time checkpoint loading, and one-time native context creation

decision_rule: every numerical, call-ledger, determinism, wall, and RSS gate must pass; there is no mean-gain override
success_action: authorize one separately frozen, already-open p14 feasibility run of this exact runtime; do not authorize fresh, validation, test, or a paper claim
failure_action: freeze the negative synthetic result and stop the fused native runtime route before any fit access
forbidden_adaptation_after_execution: changing batch size, model weights, architecture, compiler flags, solver, alpha, reference, metrics, or thresholds
using synthetic results to tune a second v13 implementation
opening fit, fresh, validation, or test data to rescue a failed pre-fit gate
claiming real BOST, physical same accuracy, generalization, algorithm breakthrough, or paper success
